protocol.anchor_detail: all eligible IDs and eligible-value summaries; p/q/components for union of pre-conflict and surviving anchors
protocol.counterfactual: native TaskAlignedAssigner with box-only overlap; same decoded predictions, candidate-center rule, alpha/beta/topk/topk2; descriptive only
protocol.ineligible_owner_edge_case: retain native zero-overlap conflict ownership; flag it and leave unevaluated pair components null
protocol.inputs: unaugmented BGR images; native LetterBox(auto=True,stride=32,scaleup=False,new_shape=(1280,1280)); RGB tensor divided by255
protocol.model_mode: eval, unfused, FP32; all BatchNorm and dropout remain in eval
protocol.models: the two complete final checkpoints returned by PR157
protocol.native_overlap: mean(clamped CIoU, known-only OKS), or clamped CIoU for zero known corners
protocol.prediction_pool: both raw native output heads, before confidence filtering or NMS
protocol.q_for_unassigned_anchor: zero for this target; never borrow the target score of another object
protocol.score_differences: p minus q on anchors assigned to this target; not calibration against observed correctness
